scope: Promoted the frozen E2 q50 agreement replacement authority and fixed H4 Giveback-20 continuation authority to the hash-bound P8U research-canonical contract. The active exchange-writing gateway and its live release were deliberately not changed.

causality.entry: E2 uses target-free decision-time inputs and is the boolean intersection of independent H0/H3 q50 predictions. It may replace only an existing paired incumbent and cannot add capacity.
causality.continuation: H4 is evaluated only after a completed 15-minute state bar. Its fixed action applies to the following interval only and cannot arm and exit on one bar, loosen a parent threshold, change sizing, or modify the hard stop.
causality.outcome_handling: August gradual-controller comparison joins policy outcomes only after target-free entry selection and uses a common source-valid population. Its neutral adapter has zero net-bps, exit-bar, and exit-reason differences versus the canonical rich parent on all 700 retained paths.
causality.costs: The rich parent policy records its 100-bps all-in round-trip cost exactly once.

validation.results: The gradual replay completed; neutral parent parity passed with zero numerical, exit-bar, and exit-reason differences. The focused canonical contract suite passed 3/3 tests, including artifact hashes, E2 boolean-intersection authority, and fixed H4 next-interval authority.
